text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, today is the speech 
showdown with that famous Trainer! A 
pedigree background and plenty of 
achievements to boot.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
At first, you were hesitant to 
participate. And yet... now you look 
completely raring to go.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll show you I can do it!
Yeah, I'll show you I can do it!

text_block_list.text:
"The opponent clearly possesses far 
greater ability. We will be in the 
position of challengers. However—we've 
devised a plan. We have more than enough 
chance to win!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
――Ah, it's starting! The speech from the 
prestigious club Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
'The Orthodox Method of Uma Musume 
Training'! It looks like there's nothing 
but things to learn, I'm so excited~!

text_block_list.name: Senior from a Prestigious Background
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume are specialized for running— If 
so, what should we Trainers specialize in?

text_block_list.name: Senior from a Prestigious Background
text_block_list.text:
It means guiding them so they never lose 
their way. In other words—strictly 
managing their diet and training.

text_block_list.name: Senior from a Prestigious Background
text_block_list.text:
Gain knowledge and put in the effort every 
day. If you do, the Umamusume will surely 
respond in kind.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm. Well spoken! Thou dost say thou 
wishest to surpass this presentation, 
correct?
choice_data_list: Yeah, because that's what I'm here for.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Heh. In that case—onward, to battle!

It was finally my turn to give my 
presentation. Thanks to my senior's 
speech, the audience's expectations were 
soaring through the roof.
choice_data_list: —Please take a look at this footage!

text_block_list.text:
Clicking on 'certain data' on the PC, 
footage began to play on the screen.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Is this... video game footage? Wait, 
why... and a Sengoku era game at that?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Wherever there is a battlefield, No Reason 
is there! For I am—a hero worth a thousand 
warriors!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Wait, isn't No Reason's opponent 
huge? There's no way anyone could win with 
that size differenceâ

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I lost, I tell thee—!!

Replaying the digitized VR gameplay 
footage— everyone becomes completely 
engrossed in No Reason's challenge.

However, the voices reaching her were 
urging No Reason to give up... or so it 
seemed—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Time and time again I fought... and was 
defeated! Yet all of that became my 
nourishment!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Y-You're not seriously thinking of 
competing in a tracksuit, are you? There's 
no way you can win!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Now—the overthrow begins!!
(Murmur, murmur, murmur, murmur...)

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Just how many of you actually thought I 
would win?

Looking around the venue— however, not a 
single person had their hand raised.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha~! Well, normally it would be! 
However, the outcome was different. I 
won... and here I stand.

I showed this footage for one simple 
reason. I wanted to share what I had 
learned with you.
choice_data_list: I want all of you—not to give up either.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—When nobody expects anything from you, 
you selfishly grow anxious, thinking 
you're simply incapable, you see.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Getting distracted by such wicked thoughts 
will prevent you from showing your true 
strength.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Not giving up—that is the very fire of 
wanting to win.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If you just hold onto that single spark of 
passion, you can overcome any fear or 
uncertainty, you know.

Thanks to No Reason, I finally realized 
it. The source of fear and anxiety lies 
within oneself.

"Every Umamusume is surely tormented by 
anxiety. And it is the Trainer's duty to 
guide them through it."

"Believing that you can win. Wanting to 
win. Someday, that passion will—"
choice_data_list:
I promise I'll make the Umamusume 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: —G... Guts theory?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
—Still, I can't afford to lose either, 
huh...
(Clap, clap, clap!)

text_block_list.name: Senior from a Prestigious Background
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! ...You guys are pretty neat.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Splendid, truly splendid! You made that 
entire venue your own!
choice_data_list: I was nervous, but I managed somehow!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Splendid, truly splendid! You made that 
entire venue your own!
choice_data_list: I was nervous, but I managed somehow!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I figured you might say that! Right here, 
I have the race schedule for that fellow's 
trainee!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this! Next is my grand moment in 
the spotlight!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha! Truly, we are two bodies with but 
a single soul~.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
You have done well to reach this point. 
May I rest my weight upon this shoulder of 
yours?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. Hey, Sir Strategist. We're 
stopping by the supermarket!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
We must celebrate your hard work! Come! A 
toast with cola!!
